subject: RE: Suspicious login detected
body_text: Investigation complete. No compromise was identified. The activity was caused by an employee travelling in Singapore. De : Antoine JAUMOUILLE Envoyé : lundi 1 juin 2026 17:32 À : demo.auxilium@outlook.com <demo.auxilium@outlook.com> Objet : Suspicious login detected   We detected multiple failed login attempts originating from an IP address located outside our normal operating regions. The account involved belongs to a contractor. Security team
